display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Category-Level Return Analysis
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Category-Level Return Analysis
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  REPLACE(category, '_Mall', '') AS normalized_category,
  COUNT(*) AS return_count,
  COUNT_IF(return_sub_type = 'FIRST_RET') AS first_returns,
  COUNT_IF(return_type = 'Courier Return RTO') AS rto_count,
  COUNT_IF(return_price_type = 'Wrong/Defective Return Price') AS defective_returns
FROM zs_observe.meesho_returns
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_count DESC;
